literal_meaning: অলসতা বা কাজ না করার প্রবণতা
figurative_meaning_en: Attempting to avoid work or responsibilities by making various excuses
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় গড়িমসি করে কাজ এড়িয়ে যায়।
অফিসে গড়িমসি করলে কোনো উন্নতি হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He always engages in gadrimasi to dodge his work.
Shirking duties like that won't lead to any progress in the office.
note: গড়িমসি is a common colloquial term in Bengali for laziness, often used idiomatically to describe evasive behavior.
